LESSON: GUIDED READING: FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.1 Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet (2 sessions) • Arabic Alphabetic Char
Topic 2.6: Guided Reading: Fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Reading: Fluency. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to read words with correct pronunciation?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply appropriate pronunciation when reading simple words for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED READING: FLUENCY
This lesson teaches Guided Reading: Fluency for Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. apply appropriate pronunciation when reading simple words for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Reading: Fluency using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Reading: Fluency above.
2. Explain Guided Reading: Fluency to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Reading: Fluency.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Reading: Fluency with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Reading: Fluency important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to read words with correct pronunciation?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. apply appropriate pronunciation when reading simple words for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
